_note: Vercel's serverless cron sends a GET request to `path` and does not include custom headers, so it cannot send x-cron-secret. The /api/cron/refresh route therefore also accepts the secret via a `?secret=` query param as a fallback. If deploying this cron to Vercel, update the path here to include the query param, e.g. "/api/cron/refresh?secret=YOUR_CRON_SECRET", and set CRON_SECRET in the Vercel project's environment variables to match.
